stories.headline: Horoscope for Sunday, 07/26/26 by Christopher Renstrom - SFGATE
stories.summary: LIBRA (Sept. 22 - Oct. 22): You're surrounded by people, but never felt so alone. Blame it on Saturn retrograde. Counter isolating tendencies and reach out.
stories.why: Saturn retrograde blame-shifting has become the mainstream excuse for male emotional avoidance—this signals how readily men outsource accountability to astrology rather than examining their own isolation patterns.

stories.headline: The Doom Boom: Marvel Studios Brings ‘Doomsday’ and More to Its Most Crowded Comic-Con Panel Ever - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: Big reveals, exclusive footage, and costumes for everyone!
stories.why: Marvel's unprecedented Comic-Con presence signals the franchise is doubling down on spectacle-as-event in an era where streaming has fragmented audiences; for men 25-45, it's less about stories and more about belonging to a live cultural moment.

stories.headline: Comic-Con 2026: David Jonsson is new Black Panther, Ryan Gosling joins Marvel as Ghost Rider - AP News
stories.summary: David Jonsson is the new Black Panther — the son of Chadwick Boseman’s T’Challa. “Black Panther” director Ryan Coogler made the announcement Saturday evening in front of cheering fans at Marvel Studi…
stories.why: David Jonsson replacing Chadwick Boseman's legacy as Black Panther is a watershed moment—it tests whether audiences accept recasting iconic roles or demand original characters, fundamentally shifting how franchises handle irreplaceable figures.

stories.headline: 'Carrie' Schools Comic-Con With Prime Video Release Date & Trailer - Deadline
stories.summary: During a panel at Comic-Con, Prime Video revealed an Oct. 7 release date for Mike Flanagan's 'Carrie' limited series and the first teaser trailer.
stories.why: Mike Flanagan's 'Carrie' remake on Prime signals prestige streaming is now confidently remaking untouchable Stephen King properties; for this demo, it's about whether nostalgia IP can justify existence beyond brand extension.

stories.headline: We Just Saw Even More Footage From ‘Avengers: Doomsday,’ and Deadpool? - Gizmodo
stories.summary: The Marvel Studios Hall H panel at San Diego Comic-Con did not disappoint in terms of Doomsday footage.
stories.why: Deadpool's integration into the broader MCU (implied by his presence at Doomsday footage) marks the R-rated irreverence that won him a fanbase finally mainstreaming into family-friendly Marvel—a tonal shift that matters for what heroes are allowed to be.

stories.headline: ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Trailer Rocks Comic-Con: Doctor Doom Raises Army of Sentinels to Take Down Avengers, Fantastic Four and X-Men - Variety
stories.summary: Marvel Studios chief Kevin Feige surprised San Diego Comic Con attendees with exclusive footage of "Avengers: Doomsday."
stories.why: Doctor Doom uniting Sentinels, Avengers, Fantastic Four, and X-Men signals Marvel is finally delivering the crossover scale fans have demanded for 15 years; for men who've waited through phases of setup, this is the payoff moment that justifies the investment.

stories.headline: Courtney Stodden addresses ‘Seinfeld’ star Jason Alexander’s apology donation for ‘inappropriate’ comedy sketch - Page Six
stories.summary: Stodden put Alexander on blast Monday in a scathing social media post.
stories.why: Courtney Stodden publicly rejecting Jason Alexander's apology-donation exposes how male celebrities still think money solves accountability—it's a watershed for what counts as genuine vs. performative reckoning in 2026.

stories.headline: Ted Danson wanted to 'stop being a liar' at the end of 'Cheers' saying he 'f---ed up' his life so badly - Fox News
stories.summary: Ted Danson revealed on his podcast that he "f---ed up" his personal life so badly he didn't even realize that "Cheers" had ended back in 1993.
stories.why: Ted Danson admitting he was emotionally checked out during 'Cheers'' finale at age 45 normalizes a generation of men realizing midcareer they prioritized success over presence—it's the inverse of 'having it all' that resonates with men questioning their own choices.
